references.quote:
// ValidTrailerHeader reports whether name is a valid header field name to appear
// in trailers.
// See RFC 7230, Section 4.1.2
func ValidTrailerHeader(name string) bool {
	name = textproto.CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey(name)
	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "If-") || badTrailer[name] {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

var badTrailer = map[string]bool{
	"Authorization":       true,
	"Cache-Control":       true,
	"Connection":          true,
	"Content-Encoding":    true,
	"Content-Length":      true,
	"Content-Range":       true,
	"Content-Type":        true,
	"Expect":              true,
	"Host":                true,
	"Keep-Alive":          true,
	"Max-Forwards":        true,
	"Pragma":              true,
	"Proxy-Authenticate":  true,
	"Proxy-Authorization": true,
	"Proxy-Connection":    true,
	"Range":               true,
	"Realm":               true,
	"Te":                  true,
	"Trailer":             true,
	"Transfer-Encoding":   true,
	"Www-Authenticate":    true,
}
references.en: ValidTrailerHeader canonicalizes the name through textproto then rejects the If- prefix or names in badTrailer; there is no local ValidHeaderFieldName call. Canonicalization semantics are an unreviewed dependency here.
references.pt-BR: ValidTrailerHeader canonicaliza o nome por textproto e então rejeita o prefixo If- ou nomes em badTrailer; não há chamada local a ValidHeaderFieldName. A semântica da canonicalização é uma dependência ainda não revisada aqui.
references.review_method: Same-agent complete two-file read and static reasoning; not independent human review/model response.
